notes.title: Welcome Aboard, New & Returning Steam Sailors!
notes.content:
Warm welcome to all new and returning Steam players of MarineVerse Sailing Club
Welcome aboard! Whether it’s your first login or you’re coming back after a break, we’re stoked to have you sailing with us.

Join the community
Meet other sailors, find crew, and share feedback in our Discord: https://discord.gg/marineverse

Quick start

Check the Game Manual for controls & tips: 

[dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1835729726"][/dynamiclink]

Say hi in Discord and tell us what boat or mode you’re into.

Feedback welcome
Controls confusing? Feature idea? Bug? Drop specifics in Discord so we can fix the right things. 



We read everything.



Fair winds—see you on the water! ⛵

notes.title: Cruising Yacht - S/V UMA
notes.content:
🆕 New Boat Added – S/V Uma (Cruising Yacht)


Step aboard the legendary S/V Uma, now available in MarineVerse Sailing Club!  

Created in collaboration with Dan & Kika from Sailing Uma, this iconic cruising yacht is ready for your next VR adventure.

⛵ Why you’ll love it:

Realistic cockpit layout and sailing mechanics  

Designed with input from real liveaboard sailors  

Perfect for relaxed cruising or global voyages in the Globe Beta

🎯 How to sail Uma:

Go to `Main Menu → Free Sail → Cruising Yacht

This is your chance to explore what long-distance cruising feels like — no ocean required.

notes.title: WINDY WEDNESDAY RACING - 7PM CST EVERY WEEK
notes.content:
🌊⛵ Awesome Sailing in Multiplayer Today!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323982/409ba62eb90325edebfde3f1720fb3dbe25755ec.png

It’s great to see our community growing. Although our live multiplayer group remains intimate, it represents just the tip of the iceberg. I'm thrilled to see our fleet growing as we sail towards becoming the world's largest virtual sailing club.

🕕 Join us next time—Sunday at 6 PM Central.
Don’t miss the chance to be part of something bigger and experience the best of virtual sailing with real enthusiasts from around the globe.

Events calendar: https://lu.ma/vr-sailing

Top 5 tips

If you are new to VR Sailing, watch: https://www.facebook.com/reel/850667043158935

Here are the top 5 tips to master MarineVerse Cup and climb the leaderboards!

Think VR sailing is too challenging? Think again! With these tips, you'll be sailing like a pro in no time!

Tip 1: Master the Basics.

Start with the tutorials. Learn the controls and get a grip on wind dynamics. These basics are crucial for your success!

Tip 2: Use Ghost Mode.
Replay your previous races in Ghost Mode. Watch how top players navigate the course and try to beat their time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323982/c32e69b74354d2f5a0b32f5d9d90d4ec79cfa647.png

Tip 3: Participate in Daily Practice Races.
Join the daily practice races. In this ghost racing mode you will experience different wind conditions and courses - improve your adaptability and racing skills.

Tip 4: Engage with the Community.
Join the MarineVerse Discord. Discuss strategies, share tips, and learn from other experienced sailors.

Tip 5: Join Multiplayer Events
Once you've gotten your feet wet Daily Practice Races, it's time to jump into Fun Multiplayer  Racing!  Every Sunday at 6 PM and Wednesday at 7 PM Central Time, race with other players, hone your skills, and enjoy the thrill of competition.

Summary

By following these tips, you’ll see a significant improvement in your VR sailing skills and start climbing those leaderboards!

Imagine the thrill of crossing the finish line first and seeing your name at the top of the leaderboard – it’s exhilarating!

Ready to take your VR sailing to the next level? 

Dive into MarineVerse Cup and start your journey to the top!

notes.title: Bofh representing UK wins Autumn Race Series 2019!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323982/299bc60726bc208167f59c8116c9da7bf5d606df.jpg

After 90 yacht races in virtual reality we have a winner of Autumn Race Series 2019! 

The title of the best VR sailor in the world goes to Bofh representing UK! He was competing against 35 other sailors from around the globe. 

Second place goes to Aaron Sawyer from the USA, who was the winner of Summer Race Series. On the third place, Mike36 from UK, who again takes the spot in the top 3 globally.

Starting today, we are competing for the title of the best global VR sailor again. It could be you! 

Learn and practice sailing, race  with us in Winter Races Series 2020 in MarineVerse Cup and represent your country!
